formal_statement: ∀ (σ β : Type) (s h k D : ℕ) (F : Set (MvPolynomial σ (ZMod 2))) (g : β → Fin s → MvPolynomial σ (ZMod 2)) (f : MvPolynomial σ (ZMod 2)), (∀ v : σ, MvPolynomial.X v * MvPolynomial.X v + MvPolynomial.X v ∈ F) → (∀ b i, (g b i).totalDegree ≤ 1) → 1 ≤ h → 1 ≤ k → 2 * h + 1 ≤ D → f.totalDegree ≤ k → (∀ b : β, h * (k + 1) < Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (Submodule.span (ZMod 2) (Set.range (g b))) → (1 : MvPolynomial σ (ZMod 2)) ∈ Submodule.span (ZMod 2) (Set.range (g b)) ∨ ∃ a : Fin s → MvPolynomial σ (ZMod 2), (∀ i, (a i).totalDegree ≤ k - 1) ∧ f = ∑ i, a i * g b i) → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCRefutable ((MvPolynomial.rename (Sum.inl : σ → σ ⊕ (β × Fin h × Fin s))) '' F ∪ {p | ∃ (b : β) (i : Fin s), p = MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl (g b i) * ∏ u : Fin h, (1 + ∑ i' : Fin s, MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr (b, u, i')) * MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl (g b i'))} ∪ {p | ∃ t : β × Fin h × Fin s, p = MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr t) * MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr t) + MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr t)}) D → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCDerivable F (k * (D + 1)) f
plain_statement: Rank 1 link 3. If the old F2 system F (with all Boolean axioms) plus blocks of extension variables (block b: affine inputs g_b, coefficient variables r_(b,u,i), axioms g_(b,i) times prod_u (1 + sum_i r_(b,u,i) g_(b,i)) and Boolean axioms for the r) has a degree-D PC refutation, h, k >= 1, D >= 2h+1, deg f <= k, and every block of rank above h(k+1) has 1 in its input span or f = sum a_i g_(b,i) with deg a_i <= k-1, then f is derivable from F in degree k(D+1). Lemma 7.7 of the unrefereed arXiv:2609.23015 (v2).
title: Block removal: a degree-D refutation with extension blocks gives the weight f in the degree-k(D+1) PC closure of the old system
